nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the set of stored elements of the empty van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ is empty.
nodes.title: Contents of the empty van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. The set of stored elements of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$ is the set of stored elements of $t$ together with $x$. No validity assumption on $t$ is needed.
nodes.title: Contents after insertion into a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number. For a van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the set of stored elements of $t$ is the finite set of those elements of the universe that are members of $t$.
nodes.title: Set of stored elements of a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For a natural number $m$, the empty van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ is the tree in which all $m$ summary bits and all $m^2$ cluster bits ($m$ clusters of $m$ bits each) are unset.
nodes.title: Empty van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. Inserting $x$ into $t$ gives the tree obtained from $t$ by setting bit $x \bmod m$ of cluster $\lfloor x / m \rfloor$ and summary bit $\lfloor x / m \rfloor$, leaving every other bit unchanged.
nodes.title: Insertion into a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the maximum query on the empty van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ returns no element.
nodes.title: Maximum query on the empty van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $t$ be a valid van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. The maximum query on $t$ returns no element if and only if no element of the universe is a member of $t$.
nodes.title: When the van Emde Boas maximum query returns nothing

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a valid van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. The maximum query on $t$ returns $x$ if and only if $x$ is a member of $t$ and $y \le x$ for every member $y$ of $t$.
nodes.title: Correctness of the van Emde Boas maximum query

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $t$ be a valid van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If the maximum query on $t$ returns $x$, then $y \le x$ for every member $y$ of $t$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas maximum query bounds every member

nodes.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $x$ be an element of the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. The maximum query on the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into the empty van Emde Boas tree over this universe returns $x$.
nodes.title: Maximum query on a one-element van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every $x$ in that universe, if the maximum query of $t$ returns $x$, then $x$ is a member of $t$. No validity hypothesis on $t$ is needed.
nodes.title: The maximum query of a van Emde Boas tree returns a member

nodes.summary: For a two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the maximum query first finds the greatest index $i < m$ whose summary bit is set, and then the greatest index $j < m$ whose bit is set in cluster $i$; it returns the element $i m + j$. It returns no element if no summary bit is set, or if no bit of cluster $i$ is set. When the summary bits record exactly the nonempty clusters,…
nodes.title: Maximum query of a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every $x$ in that universe, $x$ belongs to the finite set of stored elements of $t$ if and only if $x$ is a member of $t$.
nodes.title: The contents of a van Emde Boas tree are its members

nodes.summary: For every $m$ and every $x$ in the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, $x$ is not a member of the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over that universe.
nodes.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree has no members

nodes.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and all $x, y$ in that universe, if $y$ is a member of $t$, then $y$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$.
nodes.title: Insertion into a van Emde Boas tree keeps existing members

nodes.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and all $x \ne y$ in that universe, $y$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$ if and only if $y$ is a member of $t$.
nodes.title: Insertion into a van Emde Boas tree leaves other elements unchanged

nodes.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every $x$ in that universe, $x$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$.
nodes.title: An inserted element is a member of a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and all $x, y$ in that universe, $y$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$ if and only if $y = x$ or $y$ is a member of $t$.
nodes.title: Membership after insertion into a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: An element $x$ of the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ is a member of a two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ when bit $x \bmod m$ of cluster $\lfloor x / m \rfloor$ of $t$ is set. The summary bits are not consulted.
nodes.title: Membership in a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every $m$, the minimum query of the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ returns no element.
nodes.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree has no minimum

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. The minimum query on $t$ returns no element if and only if no element of the universe is stored in $t$.
nodes.title: Empty minimum query in a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$ be in the universe. The minimum query on $t$ returns $x$ if and only if $x$ is stored in $t$ and $x \le y$ for every $y$ stored in $t$.
nodes.title: Characterization of the van Emde Boas minimum

nodes.summary: For every $x$ in the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the minimum query on the two-level van Emde Boas tree obtained by inserting $x$ into the empty tree returns $x$.
nodes.title: Minimum of a one-element van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If the minimum query on $t$ returns $x$, then $x \le y$ for every $y$ stored in $t$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas minimum is a lower bound

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If the minimum query on $t$ returns $x$, then $x$ is stored in $t$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas minimum is stored

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If some summary bit of $t$ is set, let $h$ be the least cluster index whose summary bit is set; if cluster $h$ has a set position, let $\ell$ be the least one. The minimum query on $t$ then returns the element $h \cdot m + \ell$. If no summary bit is set, or cluster $h$ has no set position, it returns no element.
nodes.title: Minimum query of a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every $x$ in the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the predecessor query for $x$ in the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree returns no element.
nodes.title: Predecessor queries in the empty van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$ be in the universe. The predecessor query for $x$ in $t$ returns no element if and only if $x \le z$ for every $z$ stored in $t$.
nodes.title: Empty predecessor query in a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$ and $y$ be in the universe. The predecessor query for $x$ in $t$ returns $y$ if and only if $y$ is stored in $t$, $y < x$, and $z \le y$ for every $z$ stored in $t$ with $z < x$.
nodes.title: Characterization of the van Emde Boas predecessor

nodes.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$, $y$ and $z$ be in the universe. If the predecessor query for $x$ in $t$ returns $y$, and $z$ is stored in $t$ with $z < x$, then $z \le y$.
nodes.title: Maximality of the van Emde Boas predecessor

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the predecessor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $y < x$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas predecessor is strictly smaller than its argument

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the predecessor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $y$ is a member of $T$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas predecessor is stored

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x = hm + \ell$ with $0 \le h, \ell < m$, so that $x$ sits at position $\ell$ of cluster $h$. If cluster $h$ has a set position before $\ell$, the predecessor of $x$ in $T$ is $hm + \ell'$ for the greatest such position $\ell'$. Otherwise, let $h'$ be the greatest cluster index with $h' < h$ whose summary bit is set; the…
nodes.title: Predecessor query in a two-level van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every $m$ and every element $x$ of the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, $x$ has no successor in the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over that universe.
nodes.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree has no successors

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. Then $x$ has no successor in $T$ if and only if every member $z$ of $T$ satisfies $z \le x$.
nodes.title: A van Emde Boas successor is missing exactly when nothing larger is stored

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. Then the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$ if and only if $y$ is a member of $T$, $x < y$, and $y \le z$ for every member $z$ of $T$ with $x < z$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas successor is the least larger member

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $x < y$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas successor is strictly larger than its argument

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$, $y$, $z$ be elements of the universe. If the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$ and $z$ is a member of $T$ with $x < z$, then $y \le z$.
nodes.title: No member lies strictly between an element and its van Emde Boas successor

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $y$ is a member of $T$.
nodes.title: The van Emde Boas successor is stored

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x = hm + \ell$ with $0 \le h, \ell < m$, so that $x$ sits at position $\ell$ of cluster $h$. If cluster $h$ has a set position after $\ell$, the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $hm + \ell'$ for the least such position $\ell'$. Otherwise, let $h'$ be the least cluster index with $h < h'$ whose summary bit is set; the successor is…
nodes.title: Successor query in a two-level van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ satisfies the summary invariant: each summary bit is set exactly when its cluster is nonempty.
nodes.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree is valid

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, every element $x$ of the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over that universe that satisfies the summary invariant (each summary bit is set exactly when its cluster is nonempty), the tree obtained from $t$ by inserting $x$ also satisfies the summary invariant.
nodes.title: Insertion preserves validity of van Emde Boas trees

nodes.summary: A two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ with $m$ clusters is valid when, for every cluster index $i < m$, summary bit $i$ of $t$ is set exactly when cluster $i$ of $t$ is nonempty, that is, when some bit $j < m$ of cluster $i$ is set.
nodes.title: Summary invariant of a van Emde Boas tree

nodes.summary: For a natural number $m$, a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ consists of a summary bit vector of length $m$ and, for each $i < m$, a cluster bit vector of length $m$; bit $j$ of cluster $i$ records whether the element $im + j$ is stored. nodes.title: Two-level van Emde Boas tree

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
